text: Renata - could you book me a room separately Thursday morning for an interview I'm doing? Just need a small phone room for an hour.

Vintage column added to the Assumptions tab. Source plus date per input, no undated defaults.
Perfect, that'll make the pre-IC audit painless.

Theo - heads up, when you wire any of the Calthorpe figures into the Assumptions tab tag each input cell with both the file source and the interview date / part-N publication date. Same for the EPFNZ Marsden figures and anything off the RetailIQ scan-data export (use the date of pull there). Hugh has been firm on this in pre-IC reviews lately - every hardcoded input on the Assumptions tab needs both a named source and a vintage. The 'vintage TBC' / 'undated' flag is reserved for things we genuinely can't date, please don't use it as a default. Reviewer should be able to audit the vintage without opening the source.
Will do - adding a vintage column on the Assumptions tab so it's per-input alongside the source attribution. Cleaner than burying it in cell comments.
